sourceFacts: Children with congenital CMV may develop hearing loss later despite passing their newborn hearing test.
Regular hearing checks are recommended for babies with congenital CMV.
prompt:
Create an entirely original medical teaching concept illustration, landscape 3:2, warm hand-painted watercolour and gouache on ivory paper, fine ink contours, restrained navy labels, muted teal, ochre and peach accents, generous whitespace. Gentle storybook warmth with the precision and legibility of an educational atlas. Use written instructions only; no image reference. Meaningful visual relationships and sparse short labels, not paragraphs in boxes. NO internal anatomy, organ/eye/ear/brain/tissue cutaways, anatomical pathways, bones, diagnostic images, fake scans, realistic lesions, photorealistic skin, glossy wet flesh or 3D tissue. Neutral symbols or fully clothed surface poses only where specified. Preserve every direction, relationship and count in the explicit structure. Title and labels exactly as requested, no additional prose. Footer 'Educational schematic'. No logo or watermark.

Title 'Congenital CMV: hearing can change'. A gently curving left-to-right time path with three large stations. LEFT: newborn screening card with a teal tick labelled 'Newborn screen passed'. CENTRE: a bell icon whose outgoing sound-wave marks become faint, labelled 'Later hearing loss is possible'. RIGHT: repeated small calendar pages beside a pair of headphones, labelled 'Keep checking hearing'. A continuous time arrow runs LEFT to RIGHT through all three stations, but the line through centre is dotted to convey possibility, not inevitability. Footer note 'A pass is a starting point'. No hearing thresholds, invented audiogram, fake ear anatomy, guaranteed loss or claim all newborns need the same CMV follow-up. Use calm neutral symbols, no distressed child. STRICT: calendars must have NO dates, NO ages, NO numbers, NO month labels and NO text other than 'Keep checking hearing'. Do not invent a follow-up timetable such as 3, 6, 12 or 24 months. Use exactly three blank calendar icons with magnifying-glass symbols. No baby portrait, landscape or extra decorative slogans.
